edits.text: When the user asks to both change the cabin and the flights, the agent must first call `update_reservation_flights` to perform the cabin change and handle its price difference, then call `update_reservation_flights` again to update the flights to the new ones.
edits.reason: Prevents combining cabin and flight changes into a single tool call, which leads to incorrect price difference calculations for the cabin change.

edits.text: Before calling cancel_reservation, call get_flight_status for all flights in the reservation. If any flight has a status of 'flying' or 'landed', transfer the user to a human agent.
edits.reason: Ensures the agent follows the policy to transfer the user if any part of the flight has already been flown.

edits.text: When the user wants to cancel flights based on their duration, use `search_direct_flight` for each flight segment to find the scheduled departure and arrival times to determine which flights meet the criteria.
edits.reason: Fills a gap by instructing the agent to use the correct tool to retrieve the times needed to calculate flight durations.
